n9da079c1ed.headline: Sensex, Nifty in free fall: What will it take to reassure nervous investors?
n9da079c1ed.summary: Indian benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty are in steep decline as unprecedented global equity volatility unsettles investors. The RBI and other central banks are reported to be in emergency mode.
n9da079c1ed.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are the main benchmark indexes of Indian equities, tracking large domestic companies.
n9da079c1ed.why_moved: Unprecedented volatility in global equity markets has spooked investors worldwide, according to the report. Central banks are described as already acting to limit the virus's impact.

nc9bd7dfeba.headline: Rupiah at weakest since 1998 crisis as foreign investors pull out amid virus fears - Business
nc9bd7dfeba.summary: The rupiah touched levels not seen since the 1998 crisis as foreign investors pulled out of assets amid fears of a global recession over COVID-19.
nc9bd7dfeba.why: The rupiah is Indonesia's currency, and sharp moves reflect foreign portfolio flows into local bonds and equities.
nc9bd7dfeba.why_moved: Global recession fears over COVID-19 prompted investors to sell financial assets, with foreign investors pulling money out of Indonesia.

n15088b57d0.why: The European Union's single market depends on cross-border freight, so border disruption affects supply chains, trade flows and corporate earnings across the bloc.
